h1: Autonomous AI Agents Built for Australian Business
sub: Equip your team with dedicated 24/7 cloud computers that browse the web, write code, and coordinate tasks across your software stack.
audience: Founders, trade specialists, engineers, real estate analysts, and operations leads across Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, and Perth.
manifesto: Operating across distant time zones demands relentless momentum. Ceyo provides Australian founders, operators, and professionals with persistent cloud computers that research, code, and execute round-the-clock while Sydney, Melbourne, and Perth sleep.

uses.d: Bridge London and New York business hours by letting agents track overseas filings, competitors, and supply chains while you sleep.
Direct agents to monitor state mining registry portals, compile tenement tenement filings, and summarise resource compliance updates.
Scrape auction clearance rates, council planning approvals, and strata reports across Australian capital city markets into Notion.
Monitor freight manifests, customs clearance statuses, and foreign currency movements to update Google Sheets and notify logistics managers.
Task your coding bot with scaffolding React frontends, writing Python data scrapers, and deploying test builds directly in its cloud machine.
Track global grain, livestock, and fertiliser benchmark prices against local Bureau of Meteorology data to draft morning market summaries.

steps.d: Spin up an isolated cloud computer running round-the-clock in seconds.
Link your bot to Gmail, Google Sheets, Slack, and over 1,000 everyday services.
Assign research, coding, and recurring workflows via Telegram, phone, or scheduled triggers.

chapters.d: Your agents have scanned overseas markets, sorted incoming supplier emails, and posted a condensed priority list into your team Slack channel.
While you manage client meetings, your bot navigates regulatory portals, compiles fee schedules into Google Sheets, and flags policy changes.
You discuss product iterations in a Telegram group where your coding bot writes patches and your research bot pulls competitor release notes.
Even after your laptop closes and your phone goes to sleep, your persistent cloud computer runs overnight integration tests and compiles weekly reports.

faq.q: How much does Ceyo cost in Australia?
faq.a: Ceyo offers three simple tiers billed in USD: Plus at $20/month, Pro at $60/month, and Ultra at $120/month. Every plan starts with a 3-day free trial providing up to 1,000,000 tokens daily, with a card linked upon registration and billed only when the trial concludes unless cancelled.

faq.q: Does my computer need to remain powered on?
faq.a: No. Every Ceyo agent runs inside its own isolated cloud computer that operates 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, regardless of whether your laptop or phone is switched off.

faq.q: Can I interact with my bots via Telegram?
faq.a: Yes. You can manage your bots through dedicated personal Telegram chats or invite multiple specialized bots into group chats to collaborate as a unified team.

faq.q: What apps and tools can Ceyo integrate with?
faq.a: Ceyo connects to more than 1,000 platforms, including Gmail, Slack, Notion, Google Sheets, CRM platforms, calendars, and external databases via standard API connections.

faq.q: What languages and tasks do the agents handle?
faq.a: Ceyo agents support multilingual communication and research, execute autonomous browsing and form-filling, write and test code, generate deep research reports, and make voice or video calls.
